description: Read the Custom SQL Pools configuration for a workspace (governs all warehouses in it). Custom SQL Pools cap the maximum share of warehouse compute a classified workload can consume — for workload isolation/governance, not as a spending cap. Pair with 'warehouse update-sql-pools-config' to apply a configuration.
notes: A workspace with no custom pools returns {customSQLPoolsEnabled:false, customSQLPools:[]}. The endpoint is workspace-scoped and no longer requires the former beta=true query parameter (GET/PATCH /workspaces/{ws}/warehouses/sqlPoolsConfiguration). 'customSQLPoolsEnabled' toggles the feature; 'customSQLPools' holds pool definitions. Classifier type accepts the exact values 'Application Name', 'Application Name Regex', and 'Statement Type'. Capture a working configuration with this command, version it, and re-apply it with 'warehouse update-sql-pools-config --file pools.json --dry-run' first. See the 'custom-sql-pools' best-practice.
